title: Phase 3 Build Plan
eyebrow: Build plan for approval · roadmap phase 3 (#495) · twelve steps, nothing built yet

short.lead: You approved the phase 3 design (choices 1A, 2A, 3B, 4A). Cloud sessions save to their own branch. The handoff is copied onto a fresh branch, AjsAgent/phase-3-handoff, which is now on GitHub. There is one build plan and one QA. This page is the build plan: twelve steps, one issue each, tested together in one QA at the end. Steps 1 to 5 bring the handoff to main, step 6 adds the branch-build command, and steps 7 to 11 are eight small fixes. Step 12 is the proof and the QA page. The first item lists what happens to each piece of the old handoff code. Four carried issues turned out to be already fixed and are closed with evidence, not rebuilt. There are no new choices on this page.

Step 1: Save on every branch, one save per folder (#527)
Your own branch is saved, and no folder erases another's save.
Only helper branches are saved
Every branch, each folder under its own name

Copies the functions _autosave_target(agent_only=False) and _autosave_facts from the old branch into main's delegation.py. Main's one-minute gap between saves stays. A random id in .git/house-rules-folder-id names each folder's save, stored as the git ref refs/house-rules/autosave/<branch>/<folder id> (a ref is a named pointer to a save).

Step 2: Cloud sessions save to their own branch (#528)
A cloud session's unsaved work reaches GitHub.
The cloud save is refused, so nothing is saved
A commit labelled "wip: autosave" (work in progress) on the session's own branch, pushed to GitHub

Runs only in cloud sessions, which the setting CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE=true marks (checked in this one), and only on a branch the guard counts as the agent's. The guard is the check that blocks commits to branches that are not the agent's. The guard learns that lowercase ajsagent/ is the agent's, which is what blocked this session's own branch today.

One save when a turn ends normally (Stop) or fails on a limit (StopFailure), skipped when nothing changed

Steps 7 to 11: Small fixes (#534, #520 to #523)
Eight leftover problems end.
Each still true when checked on 2026-11-16
Each fixed with a test that failed before

verify.py --only for #44; the agent-field checks for #46; no leading & in handed-over commands for #137; a warning when Python is missing for #205; then #520, #521, #522 and #523 as their issues say. #523 is finished on your PC.
new
How every step is tested
The same checks as phases 1 and 2.

(1) Each step's own verify.py cases, written to fail on today's code first, then the full verify.py and tools/verify_tools.py. (2) Each helper's work is read as a diff (the list of lines it changed) and re-run, never taken from its report. (3) Live tests in real headless sessions (claude -p, the command-line Claude with no window) with only this branch's plugin: an edit saved, a session cut off, a second folder picking it up. (4) A real cloud save from this session to GitHub. (5) Your steps on a second account, desktop and cloud, on the QA page.
